predictions: A moderate 14-9 last week, plus I picked up the missing week 12 result, so we're "up to" 191-106 (64.3% correct) for the season. Doesn't feel like I'm really "up to" anything with that kind of record. Bummer.

Match of the week: (A Div.) The Bullies @ The Global Element. Well, of course this is the match of the week… month… season… year… era. This pairing has quickly become possibly the most evenly-matched, highest-talent pairing in the history of the RDL. And it's one match for it all… again. And it will likely be 1001… again. I have to take my Element!

Match #2: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Blindsided. Ohmigosh, that wk12 forfeit by Serious to the 6th place team (likely 7th if they had played). I'm saying Serious takes this, 14-10, but that's likely not enough.
Match #3: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ Runs with Corks. This is pretty close

Match #11: (G Div.) Punk in Drublic @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Yep, we finally have one head-to-head match for "that title". Not really sure how Punk is here, so I'll go with them in this one, 14-10.
